name: effect
one_liner: A programming toolkit that helps professional software teams write TypeScript apps that fail less often in production.
buyer: A CTO at a funded startup choosing the technical foundation for a new product, who wants fewer production outages.
business_use_cases: A startup adopts it as their backend foundation to reduce bugs from unhandled errors.
A dev tooling vendor builds paid training material specifically for teams migrating to it.
A staffing agency builds a niche around supplying 'Effect-experienced' contractors, a scarce skill.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a cohort-based 'production Effect' training course to engineering teams adopting it.
Offer paid production support retainers to companies running it in production.

steal_this: This weekend, record a tight 2-hour 'Effect in production' workshop and sell seats to teams already using it, found via their Discord and GitHub issues.
